verdict.rationale: The pack documents evaluations on test datasets and a Playground for prompt iteration. Neither is a sandbox environment isolated from production data. The only API console described runs against the production API, and agents are described as reading live production data. No documented sandbox, test-mode or isolated environment exists, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
